UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user profile storing account persona (startup or client), organization details, and private contact information.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

email.description: Verified account email (PII restricted to owner and admin).

accountType.description: Marketplace persona selected by the user.

contactInfo.description: Private preferred contact details for matching.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was last updated.

StartupService.title: StartupService
StartupService.description: Public startup service listing displayed in the regional directory and comparison matrix.

ownerId.description: UID of the startup owner who manages this service.

startupName.description: Bilingual startup name ({ ar, en }, each 2-120 chars).

serviceTitle.description: Bilingual service title ({ ar, en }, each 4-160 chars).

city.description: Bilingual city name ({ ar, en }, each 2-80 chars).

deliveryTime.description: Bilingual delivery timeline label ({ ar, en }, each 2-80 chars).

startingBudget.description: Bilingual starting budget label ({ ar, en }, each 2-80 chars).

summary.description: Bilingual service summary ({ ar, en }, each 10-600 chars).

idealClient.description: Bilingual ideal client profile ({ ar, en }, each 6-400 chars).

deliverables.description: Bilingual deliverables description ({ ar, en }, each 4-400 chars).

responseTime.description: Bilingual response time SLA ({ ar, en }, each 2-80 chars).

teamAndSupport.description: Bilingual team and support description ({ ar, en }, each 2-200 chars).

contactChannel.description: Public business contact channel (website or inquiry email).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when service was published.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when service was last updated.

ClientRequest.title: ClientRequest
ClientRequest.description: Private match request submitted by a client to a target startup with startup decision status and response note.

clientUid.description: UID of the client who submitted the request.

clientName.description: Bilingual client or organization name ({ ar, en }, each 2-120 chars).

clientContact.description: Client contact info shared only with the target startup owner.

needDescription.description: Bilingual description of project need ({ ar, en }, each 10-1000 chars).

budgetRange.description: Bilingual estimated budget range ({ ar, en }, each 2-100 chars).

targetStartupId.description: Document ID of the targeted startup in /startups.

targetStartupOwnerId.description: Owner UID of the targeted startup (verified against /startups on create).

targetStartupName.description: Bilingual name of the targeted startup ({ ar, en }, each 2-120 chars).

matchedCount.description: Number of matching startups in category at submission time (0-1000).

status.description: Lifecycle decision status; pending transitions once to accepted or declined.

decisionNote.description: Optional note from the startup explaining acceptance next steps or decline reason.

decidedByUid.description: UID of the startup owner or admin who finalized the decision.

submittedLabel.description: Bilingual display label for submission date ({ ar, en }, each 1-60 chars).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when request was submitted.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when request was last modified.

Conversation.title: Conversation
Conversation.description: Direct messaging thread between a client and a startup owner.

clientName.description: Display name of the client participant.

startupId.description: Document ID of the startup service in /startups.

startupOwnerId.description: Owner UID of the startup (verified against /startups).

startupName.description: Bilingual startup name ({ ar, en }, each 2-120 chars).

serviceTitle.description: Bilingual service title ({ ar, en }, each 4-160 chars).

lastMessageText.description: Preview text of the most recent message.

lastSenderUid.description: UID of the participant who sent the most recent message.

messageCount.description: Monotonically increasing count of messages in the thread (0-10000).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when conversation was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when conversation was last updated.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: Individual immutable message inside a client-startup conversation subcollection.

senderName.description: Display name of the message sender.

senderRole.description: Role of sender within this conversation.

clientUid.description: Denormalized client UID matching parent conversation for secure zero-lookup list queries.

startupOwnerId.description: Denormalized startup owner UID matching parent conversation for secure zero-lookup list queries.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when message was sent.

AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Read-only admin membership marker managed out-of-band.

/users/{uid}.description: Private user profile documents isolated per authenticated owner.

/startups/{startupId}.description: Publicly readable startup services directory with owner-restricted mutations.

/requests/{requestId}.description: Private client match requests scoped strictly to the client, target startup owner, and admin.

/conversations/{conversationId}.description: Private direct chat threads scoped strictly to clientUid, startupOwnerId, and admin.

/conversations/{conversationId}/messages.description: Immutable chat messages gated by parent conversation ownership and atomic batch update.
